sign_off.notes: NOT a clean pass. Two bugs were filed and confirmed: (1) Temperature sums: '25 celsius + 5 celsius' shows 303.15 °C and '20 celsius - 5 celsius' shows -258.15 °C (Kelvin base magnitudes leak into the result); scratchpad also showed '10 celsius + 10 celsius' = 293.15000000 °C. (2) Time differences: negative results show a double sign, e.g. '-3 h -30 min' and '-1 d -16 h -30 min'. Checked and correct: Temperatures conversions (14 °F, -40 °C, -53.89 °C), Number bases, Date gaps (incl. negative '-1 wk'), Expenses/Monthly budget totals, Remainders, Percentages, scratchpad 'in'/'to' keywords (5 km, 212 F to C, 2 hours to minutes), rotation, persistence across backgrounding for precision. Result precision applies to every line at 3, 8 and full precision. Environment left changed: result precision is ON with 4 decimal places (default was 2) because the slider could not be set reliably by swipe; please restore to 2 decimals.
